decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up lift and forward tilt for the two outer cameras; estimate tabletop geometry from calibrated head RGB.
Align open grippers over the outer cameras, rotating toward their long axes while retaining elbow-up continuity.
Descend the last four centimeters and close around both outer cameras; grasp retention must be checked after lifting.
Lift both cameras to verify retention. Move the left camera toward white; carry the right camera toward a central tabletop handoff, without crossing the arms.
Both cameras remain visible in the closed grippers. Lower left over the white basket; position right above the clear central-front handoff area.
Release the left camera into white, withdraw upward toward the remaining center camera, and lower the right camera onto the clear central-front tabletop for transfer.
Open right to leave the camera at the center-front transfer spot, withdraw to the right, and approach the remaining center camera with the left gripper.
Grasp the center camera with left. Reorient right above the red car to close across its width; the transferred camera is now visible on the central-front table.
Lift and carry the center camera toward white. Adjust right forward over the red car, close across its body, and start a small retention-check lift.
Lower the held camera into white while lifting the red car clear and carrying it toward the blue basket; keep both closed until positioned.
Release the retained camera over white and retreat from the continuity boundary. The red car remained on the table; reopen and approach it lower and nearer its middle.
Corrected the rejected tensor; center right jaws over the red car, close and test lift. Bring left toward the transferred camera.
Lift the red car and carry it forward toward blue. Approach the transferred camera with left, keeping its wrist on the left side of the midline.
Red car was not retained; reopen and approach again. Use wrist alignment for the transferred camera, close left and make a small test lift.
Carry the camera toward white with left. Shift right jaws toward the car's middle rather than its rear, lower and close for a fresh grasp.
Continue the retained camera toward white. Reopen right and lower farther to grasp the low sports car at its sides rather than above the roof.
Position the third camera farther inside white. Lift right vertically to check whether the lower car grasp retained it.
Release the third camera over white and retreat from the IK boundary. The red car is now visibly pinched on its side; carry it toward blue while tilting the wrist forward.
Approach the light-blue car with left. Advance right over blue and open; red-car retention is uncertain after it shifted in the wrist view, so inspect its settled location next.
Close left lower around the light-blue car and make a short vertical test lift. Red car has settled outside blue and will need recovery. Withdraw right toward the silver watch.
The light-blue car is visibly retained. Lift and carry it toward blue with a gradual forward tilt; lower right above the silver watch while leveling its jaws.
Move the retained light-blue car into the blue basket without releasing yet. Lower right around the silver watch, close, and test retention with a short lift.
Release the light-blue car into blue and retreat left toward the red-car recovery area. Lift the pinched silver watch and carry it toward red with a gradual forward wrist tilt.
Light-blue car is settled in blue. Reorient left vertically across the red car's width and approach it. Silver watch was not retained; return right open for a deeper grasp.
Replan from the interrupted pose without further left rotation. Move slowly down and back over the red car; refine right alignment to the silver watch using its wrist image.
The red car is centered between left jaws; descend to its sides and close. Close right around the silver watch band at the current contact height. Test both with short vertical lifts.
Lift the visibly pinched red car without rotating it, then advance toward blue. The watch escaped the ring grasp; reopen right and target its solid watch face instead.
Avoid the left continuity boundary by lowering and tilting forward gradually to place the retained red car over blue. Refine right toward the silver watch face and close.
Open left to settle the red car in blue, then retreat. Lift the silver watch vertically with the right gripper closed to verify retention before transporting it.
Cars are visible together in blue and cameras in white. Carry the silver watch toward red without rotating the tenuous grasp; begin returning the left arm toward origin.
Silver watch remains retained. Move it fully over red and release; continue the left arm's gradual return to origin.
Finish opening over red and withdraw toward the remaining green watch. Use much smaller left increments for the final approach to origin after the continuity rejection.
Silver watch is settled in red. Keep left at origin and approach the remaining green watch with right, preserving the successful watch-grasp orientation.
Target the green watch's solid face rather than the empty ring, descend slowly, and close before a separate retention-check lift.
Keep the right gripper fully closed and lift vertically to check whether the green watch remains captured.
The green watch was not retained. Reopen and shift toward its solid face using the wrist view, then descend for a better centered grasp.
Refine the right gripper slightly toward the green watch face and lower along the tilted approach, then close around the solid case.
Allow the right gripper to finish closing, then make a small vertical retention test before carrying the green watch.
The green watch appears caught against the closed jaws. Lift it gently and begin carrying right toward red without changing wrist orientation; check retention again.
The green watch remains stationary against the jaws during lift. Carry it over the red basket, maintaining the same orientation and closed gripper.
Lower the green watch slightly inside red, open to release it beside the silver watch, and withdraw upward for visual confirmation.
Both watches are now visible inside red, with cars in blue and cameras in white. Retract the open right arm and gradually unwind its wrist toward origin, keeping elbow-up continuity.
Continue the open right arm's smooth return toward its original position and orientation. Leave the sorted objects undisturbed to settle.
Bring right close to origin with small translation and rotation increments, retaining elbow-up continuity and both grippers open.
